In Team Simulation, you can skip once when choosing a Strategy
Only some Operators belonging to specific Alliances appear in the Dispatch Center
Even when frozen, the Dispatch Center can still be manually refreshed
Special level-up rewards cannot be refreshed or frozen, and are not kept to the next Round
Dispatch resources in the Temporary Bench are automatically destroyed when the next Round begins
Some special Alliances can activate without deploying Operators
After an Operator is promoted, equipped Equipment returns to the Bench and must be equipped again
Two pieces of Equipment with the same name can be combined into a stronger one
Certain Equipment combinations can grant Operators additional Alliance effects
Alliance Stacks are kept for the entire simulation, but only take effect while the Alliance is active
In most cases, only active Alliances can gain Stacks
During the Rest Phase, you can view the enemy units you will face this Round
You can cancel Ready at any time before all participants are ready; once the battle is ready, no further actions can be taken
Only teammates who achieved a Perfect Battle can Unite
In the Final Assault, two participants share the same Battlefield, but cannot view the other pair's Battlefield
In the Final Assault, everyone deals damage to the Enemy Leader together
Meet certain conditions to unlock the Hidden Core after the Final Assault
